title: Platform Navigation And Panel Mechanism
description: Build general platform navigation (URL-synced back/forward/up/breadcrumb + six panel slots with navbar toggles only when apps register tabs). Implement in sketchpad.
summary: Implemented general platform navigation: PanelKind + panelTabs on core/platform, URL-synced history wrapper (back/forward/up/breadcrumb), dynamic panel toggles only when apps register tabs, options renamed to settings. Wired sketchpad with applyUri, breadcrumb labels, windows/workbench/details panel tabs; removed manual browser history wiring.
